goal: Read-only prüfen, ob I74+I76 über eine bereits vorhandene Connection-/Factory-Seam als dünner HealthReadPort-Provider verdrahtet werden dürfen; ohne eindeutige TUI-Ownership dokumentiert stoppen

guide_delta.topic: Health Provider Wiring und Connection Ownership
guide_delta.summary: I77 bestätigt eine technische read-only Connection-Factory und einen Web-spezifischen Lifecycle, aber keine autorisierte produktive TUI-Connection-/Provider-Ownership. Ergebnis: NO_PROVIDER_WIRING_AUTHORIZED.

tests_required: confirm open_connection(read_only=True) exists without changing storage
confirm web startup owns its connection lifecycle only for the web runtime
confirm current TUI remains a consumer of injected TuiDataPort and has no connection ownership
confirm no productive TUI Health provider ownership has appeared since I71
Manifest V2 and strict write_files scope validation green
tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because no product code changes
database regressions because storage is untouched
TUI runtime tests because runtime is untouched
full suite because I77 is scope-only
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: implementing a provider now could create a second connection or ambiguous close ownership
the existing web lifecycle must not be silently promoted to TUI ownership
non_changes: no events, writer lifecycle, Composition Root or starter
expected_side_effects: provider implementation remains blocked until TUI connection ownership is explicitly authorized
the existing web lifecycle remains isolated
